text: Charms are worn seals. Each carries a totem voice and a boon, and you can wear up to **three** in Tribal Power's own charm slots. No other mod is needed.
pages.title: Spirit Charms
Wearing charms
text: Use a charm to wear it. Crouch-use any charm to open the three slots.
Worn charms cost **2 Pulse per voice every two seconds** from a carried Pulse Cell. When the cells run dry the boons stop, flight with them, so recharge or unequip.
Voices add up across everything you wear, but the same voice twice gives its boon once.
An attuned [familiar](familiar_boons) nearby that shares a charm's voice cuts that charm's upkeep by **40%** and adds a boon of its own.
Worn charms fall to the ground when you die, unless your world keeps inventory.

pages.title: The eleven charms
text: - **Sky** (Air): creative flight while Pulse lasts, as with any charm that carries Air except the Gathering Charm.
- **Ember** (Fire): fire resistance, and attackers catch flame for 3 seconds.
- **Tide** (Water): water breathing and a swimmer's grace.
- **Root** (Earth): resistance.
- **Lantern** (Spirit): night sight, and every blessing or boon you gain while it is paid for lasts **half again as long**.

pages.title: The eleven charms, continued
text: - **Spindle** (Loom): luck, and about three times in ten it refunds up to **2 Pulse** into a carried cell every two seconds.
- **Ward** (Earth): turns aside about one projectile in four, or one in two if Spirit is also on your charms.
- **Hearth** (Fire): keeps you fed.
- **Veil** (Spirit): hides you while you sneak.
- **Gathering** (Air): draws drops and experience to you.
- **Chorus**: starts silent, and learns from a brazier.

pages.title: Chorus and extra voices
text: A silent Chorus still costs 2. Crouch-use it on a Ritual Brazier with **three different totems** within 8 blocks and **200 Pulse**, and it binds every voice nearby.
Crouch-use a charm on a Resonance Totem to add that voice for **40 Pulse**. More voices cost more to wear and do more.

Ward and Hearth carry Earth and Fire, so they also give resistance and fire resistance. Air gives slow falling as well, unless Fire is worn too. Flight comes with the Air voice, not the Sky Charm alone: any worn charm that carries Air, Sky's own or one you added, lets you fly while Pulse lasts. The Gathering Charm is the one exception: its own Air goes into the pull.

pages.title: The Gathering Charm
text: While worn and paid for, it draws dropped items and experience to you from **5 blocks**, **2 more per extra voice**, up to **11**.

**Sneak** to pause it so you can drop things. A stack someone just threw is left alone until it can be picked up, a stack kept for another player is theirs, and items another mod marks as not to be moved stay put.
Its Air goes into the pull, so unlike Sky it gives no flight and no slow falling. Voices you add to it work as on any charm.
